info.name: LMS — Bhawana Capital
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the Bhawana LMS (Loan Management System).

Run folders top-to-bottom. Every request writes any extracted IDs/tokens back
to the environment, so you can execute the full chain via Collection Runner
without copy-pasting values.

Lifecycle covered:
  0   → health
  1   → admin auth (auto-rotates bootstrap password on first run)
  2–4 → LSP / product / user / API-client onboarding
  5–7 → loan origination → documents → approval → disbursement → schedule
  8   → 12 installment payments → loan closure
  9   → business-management demo views (KPIs, DPD, alerts, 360)
  10  → MIS report (async queue + sync + preview)
  11  → logout

Pair this collection with the three manual UI checks listed in postman/README.md.

item.name: 0. System Health
item.description: Fail-fast if the backend is unreachable.

request.description: Liveness probe (not aggregate /actuator/health, which can be DOWN when the DB pool is saturated).

item.name: 1. Admin Auth & Bootstrap
item.description: Authenticate as the seeded SYSTEM_ADMIN + rotate the bootstrap password on first run.

request.description: POST /api/v1/auth/login — password grant for ops.admin. If passwordChangeRequired, a nested call to /auth/password rotates the password to adminNewPassword (env var) and stores the new token.

exec: // Keep adminCurrentPassword explicit, but allow reruns to reuse the stored value
throw new Error('Login did not return accessToken. Status=' + pm.response.code + ' Body=' + pm.response.text());
// If this is first-ever login with the bootstrap password, change it inline
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ newPassword: pm.environment.get('adminNewPassword') }) }
if (err) { console.error('[auth] password change failed', err); return; }
if (resp.code !== 200) { console.error('[auth] password change HTTP ' + resp.code + ': ' + resp.text()); return; }
if (!changed.accessToken) { console.error('[auth] password change response did not include accessToken: ' + resp.text()); return; }
console.log('[auth] admin password rotated to adminNewPassword');

item.name: 7. Approval, Disbursement & Repayment Schedule
item.description: Approve → LSP requests disbursement → mock success → schedule generated.

request.description: Admin transitions application to AWAITING_APPROVAL.
Admin transitions application to APPROVED_PENDING_DISBURSAL.
LSP calls the disbursement endpoint with final bank details. Locally this hits MockLoanDisbursementAdapter which stays PENDING until admin resolves it.
Demo-only shortcut. Flips the pending mock disbursement to SUCCESS → loan transitions to DISBURSED → repayment schedule is generated automatically.
Fetches the 12-installment schedule. Stored to env for the repayment loop in Folder 8.

exec: const slim = schedule.map(i => ({ id: i.id, n: i.installmentNumber, amount: Number(i.installmentAmount), dueDate: i.dueDate }));

item.name: 8. Full Repayment & Loan Closure
item.description: Loop through the 12 installments, then assert the loan auto-closes.

request.description: Pays one installment then re-queues itself via postman.setNextRequest until all 12 are done. Use Postman Collection Runner (not single-request Send) for the loop to fire.

exec: if (!raw) { console.error('[repay] installments env var is empty — run Folder 7 first.'); return; }
if (!inst) { console.error('[repay] no installment at index ' + idx); return; }
console.log('[repay] paying installment ' + inst.n + '/12  amount=' + inst.amount);
console.log('[repay] all installments paid — continuing collection.');

request.description: All 12 payments applied — loan account should be CLOSED with closureReason=FULLY_REPAID.
Only run if auto-close did not fire (e.g., pending reconciliation). Not part of the happy-path runner.

item.name: 10. MIS Reports
item.description: Async MIS export with polling + synchronous shortcuts + paginated preview.

request.description: Queues an MIS export. A background worker generates the CSV and emails it to recipientEmail.
Drains pending MIS report jobs when the scheduled worker is disabled (staging) or for faster E2E feedback.

exec: pm.test('process OK or absent (worker fallback)', () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
console.log('[mis] process processed=' + s.processed + ' completed=' + s.completed + ' failed=' + s.failed);
console.warn('[mis] POST /reports/requests/process not found — using scheduled worker; rebuild backend for manual dispatch');

request.description: Polls until the MIS request is COMPLETED. Re-queues with a 2s delay and triggers queue processing when the worker is off or slow.

exec: if (!me) { console.warn('[mis] request not found in list'); return; }
console.warn('[mis] giving up — status=' + me.status + ' attempts=' + attempts);
